Class ShamanEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.DeckCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.EventCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.ShamanEvent
public class ShamanEvent extends EventCard
Represents a Shaman Event card within the game deck.

This class extends EventCard. When triggered, it evaluates the star counts across all players. The player(s) with the most stars receive a prestige point bonus and trigger bonus-related building effects. Conversely, the player(s) with the fewest stars suffer a prestige point penalty and trigger penalty-related building interactions.

Both outcomes are handled dynamically to account for potential ties, and building interactions are dispatched using specialized Visitor classes.

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect(Player player, Game context)
      Applies the global shaman event effect by computing star rankings and dispatching rewards or penalties.

      This method retrieves the lists of maximum and minimum star holders. It then distributes bonuses via prestigePointsWon(Player, Game) to the leaders, and applies penalties via prestigePointsLoss(Player, Game) to those lagging behind.

      Note: Unlike other events, this concrete implementation currently does not call removeEvent(context) at the end of its execution block.

      Specified by:
      applyEffect in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the current active Player triggering the step
      context - the current Game context used to filter players and pass down to visitors
